status: Inspected only; CDN not activated and no billing agreement accepted
console_access: Correct bucket owner account confirmed after user switched accounts

proposed.protocol: HTTPS client access and HTTPS origin fetch
proposed.dns: CNAME to Tencent-assigned CDN target; do not add another Cloudflare proxy layer
proposed.content: Public exercise images and GIFs only. Do not broadly expose the bucket or change avatar/private data permissions.
proposed.cache: Start with one day for public static media; versioned object names or targeted purge for replacements; preserve version query parameters.
proposed.wechat: Add https://media.dosport.online to downloadFile legal domains; keep existing origin domain during transition.
proposed.upload: Continue authenticated upload through backend/COS; CDN is used for distribution, not uploads.

required_before_activation: Confirm ICP filing for Mainland China acceleration
Review CDN service agreement and billing with user
Issue/bind a valid certificate for the media hostname
Verify public asset scope and any private-origin authorization before granting access
Configure CNAME, cache rules and HTTPS
Measure response headers, cache hits and GIF playback from real phones before switching existing asset URLs

sample_public_gif.note: CDN reduces repeated/network distance cost; optimize GIF encoding separately if needed.
